questions.answer: Instance attrs (self.name) are per-object; class attrs (User.platform) are shared via the class. Instance method takes self and uses object state; classmethod takes cls, works on the class (e.g. from_string alt constructor); staticmethod takes neither, pure utility (is_valid_name).
questions.question: Distinguish instance vs class attributes and instance vs class vs static methods.

questions.answer: Encapsulation bundles data+methods and controls access (_balance convention, __name mangling, properties/setters). Abstraction hides how and exposes what via ABC + @abstractmethod contracts. Inheritance reuses/extends (is-a); polymorphism = same interface different behavior (duck typing).
questions.question: Explain the 4 OOP pillars with a Kakade.dev example each.

questions.answer: Inheritance = is-a (Dog is Animal, `class Dog(Animal)`), tight coupling, type hierarchy. Composition = has-a (Car has Engine via attribute), looser, flexible behavior 조합. Prefer composition unless genuine subtype.
